title: 第859章 祸水东引第858章 一个馒头引发的血案
content_zh:
“师兄！断魂草已到手，快接应我！”声音嘶哑却极具穿透力，带着“重伤濒死”的急促与“同门求援”的信任，直刺昆乾宗众人耳中！
“什么？”
昆乾宗仅存的数十名弟子顿时一惊，纷纷抬头。为首那名金丹中期的执事长老赵坤，本就因宗门覆灭而神经紧绷，一听“断魂草”三字，双眼骤然放光！
“断魂草？！六阶灵药？”他心头狂跳，“若得此草，或可修复神识，助我冲击元婴！”
更关键的是，若真是同门带回，说明宗门尚有余脉未绝！他毫不犹豫，纵身跃起：“保护同门”，其余昆乾宗弟子也纷纷响应，剑光齐出，朝断魂草飞掠方向围拢！
然而，这一动，却如捅了马蜂窝！刹那间，数道身影暴起抢夺，连半步元婴都忍不住出手！目标？不是断魂草，而是昆乾宗众人！
只因江凡那一声“师兄”，已让所有人认定：昆乾宗得了幽冥谷大机缘！断魂草只是诱饵，真正宝藏，必在他们身上！
混乱中，一道雷符失控炸开，正中那株断魂草，幽蓝灵草瞬间化为灰烬，但其残留的魂息却如雾散开，沾染在四周数十名修士衣袍、皮肤之上，那正是噬灵夔牛守护千年的气息烙印！
几乎在同一瞬，一声震碎山河的怒吼自幽冥谷深处炸裂！大地崩裂，黑雾倒卷，整座南荒平原如遭巨锤轰击！
那头五阶巅峰的噬灵夔牛，竟挣脱了谷口古老禁制的一丝束缚，双目紫焰暴涨，独角撕裂虚空，直扑崖殿而来！
它感知到了，它守护千年的断魂草，被这群蝼蚁毁了！更可怕的是，那魂息烙印，如同标记猎物的血符，让夔牛瞬间锁定了所有沾染者！
夔牛四蹄踏空，紫焰焚天，一掌拍下！三名昆乾宗金丹连惨叫都未发出，当场化为血雾；血煞宗两名杀手被紫焰扫中，神魂瞬间抽干，只剩干尸坠地；连那位半步元婴老怪都脸色剧变，急祭瞬移符，却被震得吐血倒飞！
“上当了！”赵坤目眦欲裂，终于明白，哪有什么同门？分明是有人借刀杀人！
全场大乱，而昆乾宗残部首当其冲，短短三息，崖殿血流成河，近百修士死伤过半，神魂被抽，肉身崩解！
噬灵夔牛仍在咆哮屠戮，却始终未曾望向江凡藏身之处，因他未沾半点魂息，青雷护体，气息内敛如死物。
而江凡借着这千钧一发的混乱，身形一矮，混入崖底乱石阴影之中，他迅速吞下一枚“隐息丹”，收敛全部气息，眼中无悲无喜。他早算准了，断魂草乃夔牛命脉，一旦毁损，必引其狂怒；而魂息沾身，便是催命符！
此时的断魂渊，早已鸡飞狗跳，天地失序！噬灵夔牛如疯魔降世，紫焰焚空，四蹄踏处，山崩地裂。它双目赤红，神识如网扫荡百里，疯狂搜寻那毁它千年灵草的“蝼蚁”，凡沾染断魂草魂息者，皆被它视为死敌！
吼，又是一声震天怒吼，音浪化刃，撕裂虚空！
一名北玄盟金丹中期修士刚祭出传送符，却被紫焰扫中后背，神魂瞬间抽离，肉身如枯木般坠落深渊；三名散修躲入岩缝，却被夔牛一掌拍碎整座山崖，连骨灰都未留下；就连血煞宗那位素来冷傲的圣女厉红绡，也被逼得燃烧本命精血，化作血影遁走，肩头仍留一道焦黑爪痕！
各宗天骄、散修如惊弓之鸟，哪还有半分争夺血元果的心思？此刻只恨爹娘少生两条腿！

“快逃！那畜生不分敌我！”
“我的护宗玉符都挡不住它一吼！”
“它不是五阶……它已半步化神了！”
而就在这片混乱的中心，江凡却如幽灵般，悄然立于血元果树即将破土的核心裂隙旁。他青衣染尘，肩伤未愈，却气息内敛如深潭，周身无半点断魂草魂息残留。
此刻，血元果虚影已凝如实质，红光内敛，表面血纹如活脉搏动，心跳之声清晰可闻。出世，就在下一息！
远处，夔牛仍在咆哮屠戮，无人敢近核心百丈；上方，各宗强者死的死、逃的逃，再无一人能阻他夺宝。
天时、地利、人和，尽归于他。江凡缓缓伸出手，指尖缠绕一缕归墟青雷，轻声道：“多谢夔牛兄……替我清场。”
话音未落，大地震颤，裂隙崩开，十数枚血元果如赤星破土，齐齐冲天而起！红光交织成网，映得整座断魂渊如熔炉沸腾，天地灵气狂涌如潮！
每一枚果实皆拳头大小，通体如红玉雕琢，表面血纹流转，仿佛内藏生命，轻轻搏动，散发出令金丹修士神魂颤栗的精纯血气之力！
江凡眼中雷光暴涨，不贪、不乱、不迟疑，他只取最近、最成熟的一枚，五指一握，果实入手温热，如握一颗跳动的心脏，滚烫而鲜活。
几乎同时，噬灵夔牛似有所感，猛然转头，紫焰双目如两轮焚世魔瞳，死死锁定江凡！
它认出那股气息，虽未沾断魂草魂息，却正是从幽冥谷逃出之人！更可恨的是，眼前的蝼蚁竟在它屠戮全场时，悄无声息摘走了血元果！
怒火焚天，夔牛四蹄踏空，紫焰化龙，直扑江凡后心！
但江凡哪里敢做停留？他连看都未看剩下的六枚血元果一眼，贪多必失，速退为上！雷翼轰然展开，归墟青雷自周身炸裂，《九霄雷遁》催至小成极限，甚至不惜引动一丝本源雷意！
青色流光撕裂长空，快到连半步元婴的神识都难以捕捉！紫焰巨爪擦着他后背掠过，灼烧空气，却终究慢了一瞬。
而在他身后，断魂渊已成炼狱。噬灵夔牛暴怒之下，将剩余血元果尽数摧毁，紫焰焚天，追杀残存修士；北玄盟、血煞宗余孽四散奔逃，死伤惨重；昆乾宗最后几人被恶灵围杀，彻底除名于世。
尸骨堆山，血雾翻涌，哀嚎不绝。
而这场由江凡导演的乱局，借断魂草引夔牛出谷，以假同门诱群雄互斗，趁乱夺果，全身而退，终以他独揽机缘，悄然落幕。
没有着急离开断魂渊，江凡隐于百里外一座崩塌的古祭坛下，屏息凝神，青雷内敛，连心跳都压至近乎停滞。
他目光如鹰，远远盯着那头噬灵夔牛，只见那凶兽在崖殿上空咆哮良久，紫焰扫荡八方，却始终寻不到毁草夺果之人的踪迹。最终，它发出一声不甘的低吼，四蹄踏地，转身腾跃，庞大的身躯缓缓没入幽冥谷深处，黑雾重新合拢，仿佛从未出世。
content_en:
"Senior Brother! The Soul-Breaking Grass has been obtained, come to me quickly!" The voice was hoarse but very penetrating, with the urgency of "severely injured and on the verge of death" and the trust of "fellow disciples asking for help", it pierced the ears of everyone in the Kunqian Sect!
"What?"
The few dozen remaining disciples of Kunqian Sect were suddenly startled and raised their heads. The leader, Zhao Kun, the deacon elder in the middle stage of Jindan, was already nervous due to the destruction of his sect. When he heard the words "soul-breaking grass", his eyes suddenly lit up!
"Soul-breaking grass?! Sixth-level elixir?" His heart was beating wildly. "If I get this grass, it may be able to restore my consciousness and help me attack the Nascent Soul!"
What's more important is that if the same sect is brought back, it means that the sect still has a remaining lineage! Without hesitation, he jumped up and said, "Protect my fellow disciples." The other disciples of the Kunqian Sect also responded one after another. They all fired out their swords and surrounded them in the direction of the soul-breaking grass!
However, this move was like poking a hornet's nest! In an instant, several figures burst into snatching, and even the half-step Nascent Soul couldn't help but take action! Target? Not the Soul-Destroying Grass, but everyone from the Kunqian Sect!
Just because Jiang Fan said "senior brother", everyone believed that the Kunqian Sect had a great opportunity in Netherworld Valley! The soul-breaking grass is just bait, the real treasure must be on them!
In the chaos, a thunder talisman exploded out of control, hitting the soul-breaking grass in the middle. The blue spirit grass instantly turned into ashes, but its remaining soul breath dispersed like mist, staining the robes and skins of dozens of monks around. It was the aura imprint of the soul-devouring Kui Niu that had been guarding it for thousands of years!
Almost at the same moment, a roar that shook the mountains and rivers exploded from the depths of the Netherworld Valley! The earth cracked, black mist rolled back, and the entire Southern Wilderness Plain felt like it was being bombarded by a giant hammer!
The fifth-level peak Soul-devouring Kui Niu actually broke free from the ancient restrictions at the mouth of the valley. Its eyes soared with purple flames, its horn tore through the void, and it headed straight towards the cliff palace!
It sensed that the soul-breaking grass it had guarded for thousands of years was destroyed by these ants! What's even more frightening is that the soul brand is like a blood talisman marking prey, allowing Kui Niu to instantly target all infected people!
Kui Niu's four hooves stepped into the air, purple flames burned the sky, and he took it down with one palm! The three Kungan Sect golden elixirs didn't even scream, and turned into blood mist on the spot; the two killers of the Blood Evil Sect were swept away by the purple flames, and their souls were instantly drained, leaving only their mummy falling to the ground; even the half-step Nascent Soul old monster's face changed drastically, and he tried to sacrifice the teleportation talisman, but was shocked to the point where he vomited blood and flew backwards!
"I've been fooled!" Zhao Kun's eyes were splitting, and he finally understood, how could he have any classmates? It was clear that someone was using a borrowed knife to kill someone!
The whole place was in chaos, and the remnants of the Kunqian Sect were the first to bear the brunt. In just three breaths, blood flowed into the cliff hall. More than half of the nearly a hundred monks were killed or injured, their souls were drawn out, and their bodies disintegrated!
The Soul-devouring Kui Niu was still roaring and slaughtering, but he never looked at Jiang Fan's hiding place, because he had no soul breath at all, and the blue thunder protected his body, and his breath was restrained like a dead thing.
Taking advantage of this critical moment of chaos, Jiang Fan dwarfed and blended into the shadows of the rocks at the bottom of the cliff. He quickly swallowed a "Hidden Breath Pill" and restrained all his aura. There was no sadness or joy in his eyes. He had already calculated correctly. The soul-breaking grass was the lifeblood of Kui Niu. Once it was damaged, it would cause him to become furious; and if the soul breath touches his body, it would be a life-threatening talisman!
At this time, Duanhunyuan was already in a state of chaos, and the world was out of order! The spirit-devouring Kui Niu came to the world like a crazy demon, burning the sky with purple flames, causing mountains to collapse and the ground to crack wherever its hooves stepped. Its eyes were red, and its consciousness was like a net sweeping hundreds of miles away, frantically searching for the "ants" that had destroyed its thousand-year-old spiritual grass. Anyone contaminated with the soul breath of the soul-breaking grass would be regarded as its mortal enemy!
Roar, another thundering roar, the sound waves turned into blades, tearing the void apart!
A cultivator in the middle stage of Golden Core of Beixuan Alliance had just offered his teleportation talisman, but was hit in the back by purple flames. His soul was instantly separated, and his body fell into the abyss like a dead tree; three casual cultivators hid in a rock crevice, but were slapped by Kui Niu. The entire cliff was shattered, not even ashes were left; even Li Hongxiao, the always cold and arrogant saint of the Blood Evil Sect, was forced to burn her life essence and blood, turning into a blood shadow and escaping, leaving a charred claw mark on her shoulder!
The geniuses and cultivators of various sects are like frightened birds. How can they even think about competing for the Blood Yuan Fruit? At this moment, I only hate my parents for being youngTwo legs!
"Run away! That beast doesn't know the difference between friend and foe!"
"My clan-protecting jade talisman can't stop it from roaring!"
"It's not the fifth level...it's already halfway to becoming a god!"
And right in the center of this chaos, Jiang Fan stood quietly like a ghost beside the core crack that was about to break ground in the Blood Yuan Fruit Tree. His green clothes were stained with dust, and his shoulder injury had not healed, but his aura was as restrained as a deep pool, and there was no trace of the soul breath of the Soul-Destroying Grass left in his body.
At this moment, the phantom of the blood essence fruit has become solid, the red light is restrained, the blood lines on the surface are pulsating like a living pulse, and the sound of heartbeat can be heard clearly. Born, in the next breath!
In the distance, Kui Niu was still roaring and slaughtering, and no one dared to get close to the core. Above, strong men from various sects were dying and running away, and no one could stop him from seizing the treasure.
The right time, right place, and right people all belong to him. Jiang Fan slowly stretched out his hand, wrapped a wisp of Gui Xu Qing Lei around his fingertips, and said softly: "Thank you, Brother Kui Niu... for clearing the place for me."
Before he finished speaking, the earth trembled, cracks burst open, and dozens of Blood Element Fruits broke through the ground like red stars, all rising into the sky! The red light intertwined into a network, reflecting the entire soul-breaking abyss boiling like a furnace, and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth surged like a tide!
Each fruit is the size of a fist, and its whole body is like a carving of ruby. Blood lines flow on its surface, as if it contains life. It pulses gently, emitting the power of pure blood that makes the Jindan monk's soul tremble!
The lightning in Jiang Fan's eyes surged. He was not greedy, chaotic, or hesitant. He only took the nearest and ripest one and held it with five fingers. The fruit was warm in his hands, like holding a beating heart, hot and fresh.
Almost at the same time, Soul Devouring Kui Niu seemed to feel something, and suddenly turned his head, his purple eyes were like two rounds of world-burning demon eyes, locked on Jiang Fan!
It recognized that aura. Although it was not touched by the soul breath of the Soul-Destroying Grass, it was the person who escaped from the Netherworld Valley! What's even more hateful is that the ant in front of him actually quietly picked away the Blood Yuan Fruit while it was slaughtering the entire crowd!
Anger burned the sky, Kui Niu's four hooves stepped into the air, purple flames turned into dragons, and went straight to Jiang Fan's heart!
But where could Jiang Fan dare to stop? He didn't even glance at the remaining six Blood Yuan Fruits. If you want too much, you will lose. It's better to retreat as soon as possible! The thunder wings suddenly unfolded, and the green thunder of Guixu exploded all over the body. The "Nine Heavens Thunder Escape" was pushed to the limit of Xiaocheng, even inducing a trace of the original thunder intention!
The cyan stream of light tore through the sky so fast that even half a step of Nascent Soul's consciousness could not catch it! The giant claws of purple flames brushed past his back, burning the air, but in the end it was slow for a moment.
Behind him, Duanhunyuan has become purgatory. In a rage, the Soul-eating Kui Niu destroyed all the remaining Blood Yuan Fruits, burned the sky with purple flames, and hunted down the remaining monks; the remnants of the Beixuan League and the Blood Evil Sect fled in all directions, suffering heavy casualties; the last few members of the Kunqian Sect were surrounded and killed by evil spirits, and were completely eliminated from the world.
The bones piled up on the mountain, the blood mist surged, and the screams continued.
And this chaos directed by Jiang Fan used the soul-breaking grass to lure Kui Niu out of the valley, used false comrades to lure the heroes into fighting each other, took advantage of the chaos to seize the fruits, and retreated, and finally ended quietly with him seizing the opportunity.
Instead of leaving the Duanhun Abyss in a hurry, Jiang Fan hid under a collapsed ancient altar a hundred miles away, holding his breath and concentrating. Qing Lei was restrained, and his heartbeat was almost stagnant.
His gaze was like an eagle, staring at the soul-devouring Kui Niu from a distance. He saw the ferocious beast roaring above the cliff hall for a long time. The purple flames swept in all directions, but there was no trace of the person who destroyed the grass and seized the fruits. Finally, it let out an unwilling roar, stepped on the ground with four hooves, turned around and jumped, its huge body slowly sank into the depths of the Netherworld Valley, and the black mist closed again, as if it had never been born.
